reception staff at Barrington medical centre have been nothing but fantastic. My husband and I have relocated from London back to the North West and we can’t believe how friendly and warm the reception team are. They go out of their way to help you which unfortunately is notoriously rare for GP receptionists!! I’ve also had an appointment with nurse Chelsea who was lovely and friendly.\n\nHowever I had a particularly disappointing and upsetting experience with Dr Simona a couple of weeks ago. I had an appointment to discuss my fertility options. I’ve had blood test results which show high AMH and testosterone which can be an indication of PCOS. My cycles are over 50 days long and I have a very short luteal phase. Both my mum and sister have PCOS and have unfortunately experienced a number of miscarriages and fertility struggles. We are keen to start trying for a family and so as a first point of call, I thought it would be sensible (and fair) to have a chat with my GP.\n\nI must have been sat down for less than 60 seconds before Dr Simona interrupted me and said there was nothing she could do to support me until we’d been trying for at least 2 years and/or have had multiple miscarriages. She spoke over me numerous times and completely missed the point as to why I was there. I found her to be rude and condescending.\n\nWhile I appreciate the NHS is on its knees and really struggling, I couldn’t believe her attitude and approach. While I wasn’t expecting any form of treatment or even guarantees, I really was just hoping for an empathetic and consultative conversation about my options, next steps, tips and advice.
